title: Alert Orbit — Summary Arc & On-call Pulsekit (prototype)
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Design prototype that surfaces a compact incident summary (Summary Arc) combined with a lightweight on-call context card (Pulsekit). Objective: reduce cognitive load for responders by showing immediate SLO delta, cost impact estimate, recent runbook fragments, and a one-click postmortem link — all within the Alerts/Incidents lane of the Redwood Console.
comments: 2025-01-12 — Aisha Kumar: Initial mock uploaded to Figma. Summary Arc is a single-line micro-timeline showing last 3 events (trigger, mitigation, status) + SLO delta badge. Pulsekit drafts include abbreviated runbook fragments (2–3 steps) and a 'Take Baton' action. Posted PRD link in Confluence.

2025-01-13 — Marco Li (Eng): Love the micro-timeline, but backend will need an aggregated 'incident_snapshot' endpoint to serve condensed events and SLO delta; flagged as dependency. Also noted potential rate-limit concerns for live updates when many responders open the incident view.

2025-01-14 — Priya Shah (PM): Suggested changes to priority mapping: map severity -> suggested escalation action (auto-escalate at sev P0 after 10 min). Added cost-estimate line item to Pulsekit (rough token-cost + estimated GPU-hours).

2025-01-15 — Design Review (Ivy Moreno): UI refinements — reduce punch of SLO badge to secondary color at <0.5% delta, animate only on first load, and add affordance to expand the Arc to full timeline. Also proposed keyboard shortcut 'B' to 'Take Baton'.

2025-01-16 — Security (Liam O'Neill): Confirmed postmortem link exposure is acceptable for roles with incident.read; requested audit log event when 'Copy Postmortem Link' is clicked. Marked for platform audit-change ticket.

2025-01-17 — UX Research (Nora Wang): Scheduled remote unmoderated study with 12 on-call engineers (mix of platform and product teams) to validate whether Pulsekit reduces context-switch time. Draft tasks in research plan attached.

2025-01-18 — Eng Review (Santiago Ruiz): Implementation notes — prefer to implement Arc as server-rendered svg stripe to avoid client reflow, Pulsekit to fetch runbook fragments using existing runbook-summary API; opened ENG-991122 as dependency for incident_snapshot endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype screens in Figma with annotated states: collapsed Arc, expanded Arc, Pulsekit collapsed/expanded
Design handoff tokens and component spec delivered (colors, spacing, animation timings)
Concordant PRD in Confluence with success metrics and research plan
Engineering dependency ticket ENG-991122 created and linked
Audit requirement for postmortem link click captured and assigned
design_decisions: Use single-line Summary Arc in compact contexts; allow expansion to full timeline on demand
SLO delta shown as compact badge with color thresholds: green (<0.1%), amber (0.1–1%), red (>1%)
Cost impact displays as a conservative estimate range (min–max) and links to detailed cost breakdown in Console Cost view
Pulsekit contains up to 3 runbook fragments, top contributor names, and a 'Take Baton' primary CTA that assigns the incident in backend
Animations are subtle (fade+scale) and play only on first open to avoid distraction
tech_dependencies: Console frontend: small svg micro-timeline component and keyboard shortcut hook
next_steps: Finalize high-fidelity screens and export component tokens (due 2025-01-20)
Hand off component spec to frontend with acceptance criteria (2025-01-22)
Kick off UX Research sessions and collect recordings (start 2025-01-23)
Coordinate with Eng to confirm API contracts and SLA for incident_snapshot (ENG sync 2025-01-19)
Create a lightweight experiment plan for canary rollout to 10% of incidents once backend is ready
